notes:
苹果 / iCloud 终于走境内 DNS 解析。

## 修复

- 苹果与 iCloud 的域名现在走境内 DNS 解析。此前它们被订阅里的「非国内」兜底规则先
  一步匹配掉，一直由境外解析器回答，而境外解析器没有理由返回国内的苹果节点——
  表现就是 App Store、iCloud 同步和系统更新偏慢。客户端原本有这条策略，但只在
  「订阅完全没有 DNS 策略」时才会写进去，而实际订阅总是自带策略，所以它从未生效。

## 优化

- Linux 客户端发送 HY2 流量时打开 GSO，由内核批量切分 UDP 报文，减少系统调用、
  提升上行吞吐。这是 mihomo 上游的默认值，此前 YueLink 是唯一关着它的客户端。
- 这个开关在 Linux 之外不产生任何作用（内核里的 GSO 路径只为 Linux 编译），
  Android、iOS、macOS、Windows 的行为完全不变。

## 修复

- 修正一处一直没生效的设置：这项此前只在订阅没写的时候才补，而订阅本身就写了相反的
  值，于是客户端那一半从落地起就是空转。现在由客户端权威决定。

## 兼容性

账号、订阅和节点协议兼容现有服务。更新签名公钥与平台安装身份保持一致。
Flutter 3.47.2、Dart 3.13.2、Go 1.26.8 和 Mihomo v1.19.30 稳定基线不变。
notesEn:
Apple and iCloud finally resolve through domestic DNS.

## Fixes

- Apple and iCloud domains now resolve through domestic DNS. They were being
  matched first by the subscription's "non-China" catch-all and answered by
  overseas resolvers, which have no reason to return a China-side Apple edge —
  so the App Store, iCloud sync and system updates were slower than they had to
  be. The client already carried this policy, but only wrote it when a
  subscription shipped no DNS policy at all; real subscriptions always ship one,
  so it never took effect.

## Improvements

- The Linux client enables GSO when sending HY2 traffic, letting the kernel
  segment UDP datagrams in batches. That cuts syscalls and raises upload
  throughput. This is upstream mihomo's default; YueLink was the only client
  shipping it disabled.
- The switch has no effect outside Linux — the core compiles its GSO path for
  Linux only — so Android, iOS, macOS and Windows behaviour is unchanged.

## Fixes

- Corrected a setting that never took effect: the client only filled it in when
  the subscription omitted it, and the subscription always shipped the opposite
  value, so the client half was inert from the day it landed. The client now
  owns the value.

## Compatibility

Accounts, subscriptions and the node protocol remain compatible with the current
service. The update signing key and the per-platform install identity are unchanged.
The Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2 / Go 1.26.8 / Mihomo v1.19.30 baseline is unchanged.
